company.name: Trust Micro Insurance Company Limited
company.about: Trust Micro Insurance is a micro non-life insurer licensed by the Nepal Insurance Authority that started operating in March 2024. It sells low-cost motor, home, property and accident cover, with a head office in Butwal and a province office in Kathmandu.
highlights: Newly licensed micro non-life insurer (operations began March 2024)
About 33 branches and sub-branches and around 13 products (Infomerics, 2025)
Motor insurance makes up roughly 93% of its gross premium
Micro policy cover is capped at NPR 5 million by the regulator

policies.name: Two Wheeler Motor Insurance
policies.summary: Covers your motorbike or scooter against accidents, theft and damage to other people or their property.
features: Third-party liability cover as per NIA tariff
Claims handled through branches across Nepal
benefits: Compensation for third-party death, injury and property damage
Own-damage repair cost on comprehensive plan
Driver and pillion accident cover where opted
exclusions: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs

pricing.note: Indicative third-party premium for a 150cc-250cc bike per NIA tariff; comprehensive is priced on vehicle value

bestFor: Daily bike or scooter riders needing the legally required cover

policies.name: Private Motor Insurance
policies.summary: Protects your private car or jeep against accident damage, theft, fire and third-party claims.
features: Covers cars, jeeps and vans for private use
Cover for accident, fire, theft and natural disasters
benefits: Repair or replacement cost of your vehicle
Third-party injury, death and property damage compensation
Cover for fire and theft loss
exclusions: Use for hire or commercial purposes
Damage while under the influence of alcohol
bestFor: Private car owners wanting full own-damage protection

policies.name: Ghar Beema (Home Insurance)
policies.summary: Low-cost cover for your house and belongings against fire, earthquake and other disasters.
benefits: Pays for repair or rebuilding after insured damage

policies.name: Accidental Insurance
policies.summary: Pays a lump sum if you die or are permanently disabled in an accident.
benefits: Partial or full payout for permanent disability
Medical expense reimbursement up to a set limit
bestFor: Daily wage earners and families wanting basic accident protection
